title: El castillo: sus jefes y lo que cambia al caer cada uno
description: docs/castle-bosses.md, docs/castle.md § The castle after each boss. Aurelià and the management team in their own figures (just character-3d: OpenAI + Meshy) in their fights and waiting in their rooms; then the castle as each falls: the gym and the patio the school's again with her gum clotted round the door on, the second floor harder, the secretaría an office again. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + (d || 4.2) * .28, z: p.z }, d || 4.2); };

steps.caption: Mar, Montse and Pilar, each her own figure, drawn from her own face: the Queen's marks (violet eyes, pink gum gloves, her striped paper) on top
Choosing whom to hit: her name over her head and in the picker («→ Mar»)
The cursor on Montse: her name follows it
And on Pilar
Mar, the head: the tallest, her round face and auburn hair, her mustard scarf, the wrapper-paper collar
Montse: the shortest, her ash-blonde bob, the manila cardigan over a black T-shirt, the striped paper scarf
Pilar: slim, her long dark hair and silver drop earrings, the steel-blue dress, the short cape

steps.eval: window.go = (id, x, z, flags = []) => { window.gerard.story.merge(flags); window.gerard.game.refreshStory(); window.gerard.game.setEnvironment(id, { x, z }); }

steps.caption: The gym while it is his: Aurelià waits where the fight starts, her gum on the floor
Aurelià beaten: the gym is a school gym again, quieter, none of her gum on it
What is left of her clots round the changing rooms' door: the way on
The patio behind him: the school's again
The secretaría while it is theirs: Mar, Montse and Pilar wait in Direcció
Dirección beaten: the secretaría is an office again, and she clots round Direcció's inner door

steps.eval: (() => { const floor = window.gerard.story.place('castillo-2').palace.floor, spawn = floor.spawn; window.gerard.game.setEnvironment('castillo-2', { x: spawn.x, z: spawn.z }); })()

steps.caption: The second floor, one scream on: darker, her gum creeping down the walls, and each pupil a body of its own that hunts its own way (El Repetidor winds up and charges, La Chivata points, La Delegada waits)

steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.gerard.game, floor = window.gerard.story.place('castillo-2').palace.floor, room = floor.rooms.find(r => r.encounter === 'alumnos-2a') ?? floor.rooms.find(r => r.kind === 'fight'); g.setEnvironment('castillo-2', { x: room.cell.x, z: room.cell.z }); })()
